summary: Executed iteration 50 backend+frontend verification for legal/privacy pages, native launch branding assets, and auth-gate behavior under pending bootstrap. Backend targeted suite passed 15/16; one failure exposed script injection on public legal HTML. Frontend mobile tests confirmed public-route accessibility while session pending, no PIN POST during pending bootstrap, and private-route guard redirect. One single live PIN login attempt did not navigate away from entry within wait window, so positive login remains inconclusive in this run.

critical.issue: Response HTML included injected <script> challenge block (/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform) despite requirement of no scripts/external trackers on public legal pages.

integration_issues.flow: Entry live PIN login (single approved attempt)
integration_issues.issue: After entering approved phone+PIN and tapping Sign in once, route stayed on /entry with no visible error message in this run; login success could not be confirmed.

action_items: Fix ingress/CDN behavior so /api/legal/* pages return script-free static HTML exactly as required (no injected challenge JS/iframe).
Re-verify one deterministic positive PIN login flow after bootstrap settles (ensure one tap posts once and navigates) without relaxing pending-session guard.
Keep deletion flow disabled until canonical website exposes authenticated account-deletion API; do not implement companion-only deletion or false success states.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth gate implementation aligns with requirement: PUBLIC_ROUTES stay accessible during bootstrap pending while private routes remain masked until ready && user.
Entry go() guard correctly blocks keyboard/tap submission when !ready, and entry privacy click clears PIN/confirm fields before route change.
Public legal content is shared from frontend/src/legal/content.json by backend legal router, reducing drift between native and backend content sources.

success_rate.frontend: High on executed scope (~90% critical checks passed; live login confirmation inconclusive in single allowed attempt)

seed_data_creation: No test seed data created. No canonical signup/deletion/academic mutation was performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the same approved credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, keep one-login-attempt constraint, and prioritize validating ingress script-injection removal on /api/legal/privacy plus deterministic positive login navigation after pending bootstrap settles.
rca_of_issue: RCA(critical): legal endpoint handler itself emits script-free HTML, but delivered response includes Cloudflare challenge script, indicating edge-layer injection outside app code path. Reproduction: GET public legal URL and search '<script' in returned body. Mitigation: adjust CDN/security challenge rules to bypass JS injection for legal static pages while preserving security controls.
